_description: Multi-hop questions: each needs facts from two RICOH ProcessDirector documents. Written by hand from the corpus. eval/verify_multihop.py measures that a single retrieval on the raw question misses at least one required document on 8 of the 20 (the others are compound questions about one named entity, where both documents share enough keywords to be retrieved together). This is the slice the ablation in README section 7 was missing: the 100-question set has no multi-hop questions, which is why the planner looked useless there. This set is where the planner's query decomposition has something to do. expected_sources are JOINTLY relevant (all needed), not alternatives, so provenance is 'curated'. All are answerable.

questions.question: RICOH ProcessDirector's primary server and its application servers run on different operating systems. Which operating systems does each one support?
key_facts: the primary server runs on Linux: Red Hat, Rocky Linux, or SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES)
application servers run on Windows: Windows 10 or 11 Pro, or Windows Server 2019, 2022, or 2025

questions.question: What does the FusionPro Connect feature let you do, and what must be installed on the FusionPro machine before you can configure the connection from RICOH ProcessDirector?
key_facts: FusionPro Connect lets you use FusionPro to compose documents based on predefined templates
you must install a RICOH ProcessDirector application server feature on the machine where FusionPro is installed
add the RunFusionPro step template to a workflow to send files to FusionPro Server

questions.question: After a RICOH ProcessDirector shutdown and restart, all printers are disabled. Which command stops the base product immediately without waiting for steps to finish, and which system property re-enables the printers automatically after a restart?
key_facts: stopaiw stops the system immediately without waiting for steps to complete
set the Remember enabled status of printers system property to Yes

questions.question: What are the AFP-resource limitations of PCLOut printers, and which RICOH ProcessDirector job actions cannot be used with jobs that are sent to a PCLOut printer?
key_facts: PCLOut printers do not create or save AFP resources such as fonts, overlays, or page segments from one job to the next, and cannot reuse printer resources between jobs
you cannot use the Jump and Continue actions with jobs submitted to PCLOut printers

questions.question: Which inserter manufacturers does the full Inserter feature support, and how do I create an inserter controller object when RICOH ProcessDirector does not already supply one for my controller?
key_facts: the Inserter feature supports inserters from Bowe, Gunther, Kern, Pitney Bowes, and Quadient
on the Administration tab, click Devices then Inserter Controllers, click Add, fill in the required properties, click OK, then select the controller and click Enable

questions.question: Which barcode types can I create in the AFP Enhancer mode of RICOH Visual Workbench, and in which representations can AFP Enhancer create an Intelligent Mail barcode?
key_facts: AFP Enhancer can create Code 39, Data Matrix, and Intelligent Mail barcodes (among others)
AFP Enhancer can create an Intelligent Mail barcode as BCOCA objects, Generic barcodes, Font barcodes, or DrawRule barcodes

questions.question: To send job status information to Avanti Slingshot, what URL do I configure in RICOH ProcessDirector, and what must I set on the workflow steps for the timing data to be reported?
key_facts: specify the JMF HTTP URL http://yourserver:15080/aiwservices/v1/jmf for the RICOH ProcessDirector server
associate steps with a Slingshot cost center and make sure a job passes one step with a Slingshot milestone status of Complete for each cost center

questions.question: How do I create a custom document property in RICOH ProcessDirector, and what do I have to do with it before I can use it to sort or split AFP documents?
key_facts: on the Administration tab click Objects then Custom properties, click Add, choose Document Property, set the values, and activate it with the switch
use Document Property Designer to link the custom document property to its index tag (Tagged Logical Element)

questions.question: When I pull documents out of a print job in RICOH ProcessDirector, how do I account for those pulled documents afterward, and what methods can I use to identify the documents to reconcile?
key_facts: reconcile the job manually, accounting for documents that processed successfully, were pulled from the job, or were damaged and need reprinting
identify documents by entering document property values, entering a range of Insert sequence values, or scanning a barcode with a hand-held scanner

questions.question: What does the Security feature let me control about passwords, and how do I install it?
key_facts: install the Security feature using Feature Manager; it does not need to be purchased and needs no license key
you can specify a minimum password length, a maximum age before expiration, and enforcement of password complexity rules

questions.question: In RICOH Visual Workbench, what is the difference between editing the text value of an index tag itself and editing the text for an index tag that is linked to a property?
key_facts: editing the text of a trigger or index tag changes the index tag value itself and should be appropriate for all page groups
editing the text for an index tag linked to a property changes only the property value and does not change the index tag value

questions.question: The PDF Document Support feature uses RICOH ProcessDirector Plug-in for Adobe Acrobat. What does it let you do with the individual documents in a PDF file, and where is the markup saved?
key_facts: you can rearrange the output order of documents, group them by envelope size requirements, and find a document by searching for a document property
markup is saved to one or more control files rather than in the PDF file itself, and only one control file can be loaded at a time

questions.question: For the Deadline Tracker feature, what step template does it add, and how do I track two separate deadlines within one linear workflow?
key_facts: Deadline Tracker adds a step template and three system objects
place two SetDeadline steps in the workflow, each one making a different step the deadline step

questions.question: Which printer types and output formats can RICOH ProcessDirector send jobs to, and which feature must be installed to send AFP jobs to IPDS printers?
key_facts: RICOH ProcessDirector can send jobs to Ricoh TotalFlow printers, Ricoh PDF printers, TASKalfa printers, Custom PDF printers, and any printer that receives jobs over LPD
the AFP Support feature is required to send AFP jobs to IPDS printers; its printer driver component converts the AFP data stream into IPDS

questions.question: Why do printed colors change when I switch paper stock, and what is the point of using color management?
key_facts: the paper has a significant impact on the colors you see, so printer manufacturers test and certify papers and create different ICC profiles for their printers based on paper characteristics
color management lets you control the color adjustments that are always needed because printers typically have smaller color gamuts than monitors and other devices

questions.question: To send RICOH ProcessDirector data to RICOH Predictive Insight, what has to be configured first, and where must that data be stored?
key_facts: you must configure the Reports feature first, including setting up data collectors and workflow steps to gather the data
the data sent to RICOH Predictive Insight must be stored in the Reports database by the RICOH ProcessDirector data collectors

questions.question: What is the AFP Support feature for, and what does the line-data-to-AFP transform use when it composes the data?
key_facts: AFP Support lets you control and track jobs and individual documents in AFP format, and its printer driver component converts the AFP data stream into IPDS for printers
the line-data-to-AFP transform uses a page definition when it composes the data, and page definitions specify characteristics such as the printable area and the maximum number of lines per page

questions.question: How do I add a step that runs an external program to a workflow, and how do I make a job that goes into an error state continue down a different path instead of stopping?
key_facts: on the Workflow tab, copy an existing workflow or add a new one, then add a step based on your external-program step template
define an error path by adding a branch out of a step so a job that enters the error state continues in another path in the workflow instead of staying in Error

questions.question: In the RICOH ProcessDirector Plug-in for Adobe Acrobat, what does the Media and Finishing dialog let me do, and what does the Inserts Manager dialog control?
key_facts: the Media and Finishing dialog lets you edit and delete options, select new media and finishing options, and set the order in which they are applied to a PDF file
the Inserts Manager dialog lets you add, edit, and delete page inserts from other PDF files and set the order in which they are added when the BuildPDFFromDocuments step runs

questions.question: What does the Reports feature add to RICOH ProcessDirector, and which data collectors can I configure with it?
key_facts: the Reports feature adds the WritePropsToReportsDatabase step template and the Data collector and Data transmitter objects, and stores data in a PostgreSQL database
configurable data collectors include Job Step Duration and Job Step Progress
